summary: The USB adapter is detected, but its Windows driver is not ready.
details: Windows Code 39: the adapter driver could not be loaded.
This checks Windows device status only. CAN traffic and charger communication have not been tested.

Recent Code Integrity event 3111 names usbcan.sys: that driver did not meet HVCI/Memory Integrity policy. Together with current Code 39, this indicates a driver compatibility issue; the event is historical evidence, not a new communication test.
